$comment: Single source of truth for JanMaang design tokens. Generates the Tailwind v4 @theme block and (eventually) Dart constants. The palette is the Jan Setu system transcribed from the Stitch DESIGN.md spec; the density tiers are the civic map legend and are shared with the Flutter app.

color.$comment: Emitted under Tailwind's --color-* namespace, so every key here becomes a bg-/text-/border- utility automatically.

density.$comment: Five-tier concentration scale. Same palette as the wordmark and the map legend — must not drift between web and mobile.

font.sans: var(--font-inter), ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

shadow.$comment: Level 1 ambient, level 2 floating. Interactive elements rely on colour fills, not heavy shadows.

radius.$comment: 4px baseline. Authored as numbers so the Dart side can reuse them.
